metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace (fork). Custom plugins on top of claude-code-templates.

plugins.name: pre-push-review
plugins.description: Fires an expert panel of code reviewers before every git push and blocks the push on critical findings; small pushes get a quick panel of the blocking reviewers. Portable, versioned — no per-machine hand-wiring.

plugins.name: quality-kernel
plugins.description: A quality-assurance kernel for agentic development: a seven-agent SwarmForge-style engine (specifier -> designer -> coder -> cleaner -> architect -> hardener -> QA) with deterministic quality tools, a blind live-oracle verifier, epistemic-discipline gates, and a deterministic quality gate (/gate).

plugins.name: org-workspace
plugins.description: A light global guide for an org folder of many repos: /org-init maps who calls whom and writes a short managed block into the root CLAUDE.md saying where the truth of each thing lives; /org-learn updates it from a conversation.

plugins.name: spa-kit
plugins.description: A factory for client SPAs that classic search crawlers and AI answer engines can both read. Generates a standalone Next.js site from a declarative brief, derives the whole OKLCH palette from one brand hex with enforced contrast targets, and verifies it with three independent oracles: a no-JavaScript crawler probe, a blind breaker, and a Playwright suite (visual, a11y, motion contract, web vitals). Includes the /spa-kit interview skill.

plugins.name: usage-guard
plugins.description: Keeps a Claude Code subscription inside its weekly limit: a price-weighted usage report from the local transcripts (by kind, model, session, subagent), a read-only configuration doctor that flags plan-draining settings, and a status line with four styles showing the 5-hour and 7-day limits and the burn pace. Hooks cap context per call (main and subagents) and subagent spawns per session. A prompt audit lists unused skills and agents with a skillOverrides block. claude-mem can be paused, resumed and moved to another provider.

plugins.name: pr-draft-guard
plugins.description: Rule + hook: every pull request Claude opens is a draft; Claude never merges or un-drafts one, and asks before merging a base branch into a feature branch.

plugins.name: aws-admin-guard
plugins.description: Rule + hooks: the AWS admin profile is usable only after the human authorizes it and confirms a second time in two separate typed messages; consent is read from the session transcript and expires.

plugins.name: chat-language-guard
plugins.description: Rule + hooks: Claude talks to the user in Spanish while code, commits, PRs and files stay English; a Stop check sends English replies back for a Spanish rewrite.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Addy Osmani's engineering skills (MIT), vendored at a pinned commit: skills only, no commands, agents or hooks. Six fill gaps and may be used by Claude on its own (debugging, API design, security at build time, migrations, performance, observability); the other twenty run only when typed as /agent-skills:<name>, so they never compete with quality-kernel.

plugins.name: dev-toolbox
plugins.description: One install for daily software work: bundles quality-kernel, pre-push-review, usage-guard, the two guards and agent-skills, and adds curated stack skills (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, Docker, AWS serverless, Google Cloud, Terraform/OpenTofu, Playwright, interface design and motion, LLM agents and MCP).
